name: Bless Army
text:
**Bless Army**

**School** enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; **Level** cleric 6, oracle 6, warpriest 6
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S, DF
**Range** 1 hex
**Target** one army
**Duration** 1 battle
**Saving Throw** none; **Spell Resistance** yes (harmless)

Bless army fills an army with courage. The army gains a +1 bonus
 on OM and Morale checks.
